name: How much does it cost to install under cabinet lighting in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install under cabinet lighting in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of under cabinet lighting installation in the Bay Area varies significantly based on several factors. These include the type of lighting chosen (LEDs are generally more expensive upfront but save money long-term), the number of cabinets, whether new electrical wiring is needed, and the complexity of the installation. For a rough estimate in the Bay Area, professional installation for a standard kitchen might range from $500 to $2,500, not including the cost of the fixtures themselves. We offer detailed quotes after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for under cabinet lighting installation in the Bay Area can range from $500 to $2,500, depending on fixture type, wiring needs, and kitchen size.
